messages:
caroline: Quick sync — we need to lock PRD + launch criteria for scoped API keys for Dedicated customers. Can we get acceptance criteria and a short list of edge cases by EOD?
antoine: +1. I added a rough RFC draft in the docs folder, but want product sign-off on must-have vs nice-to-have.
caroline: thanks. Kate — any customer asks that are blockers?
kate-product: A few customers want project-scoped keys and read-only creds for embeddings. Blocker is audit trail per key.
mike: For implementation, we should define token format and lookup. Proposal: `sk:{org}:{project}:{env}:{shortid}` so we can map keys to both org and project without extra DB joins. Thoughts?
sara: That format works. Edge cases: key reuse after deletion, rotation semantics, and service-to-service keys that need wildcard project scope. Need explicit acceptance criteria for each.
antoine: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Create API keys scoped to org or org+project. 2) Enforce RBAC: project-scoped keys only access resources within project. 3) Audit log entry for every token use (user, key id, resource, action, timestamp). 4) Rotation endpoint that returns previous key expiry and invalidates old key. 5) Backwards-compatible behavior for existing unscoped keys with a migration plan.
caroline: Shortenable: we need measurable checks. For (3) — logs must be queryable from Console per-key within 30s. For (4) — rotation must propagate to Dedicated nodes within 2 minutes.
security-bot: NOTE: Existing rate-limit policy will apply per-key. Recommend adding per-project burst exceptions for heavy embedding jobs.
mike: Implementation note: KV cache for lookup by key id, with fallback to DB. Cache TTL 60s; on rotation we purge cache. Also need to surface `key_id` in logs rather than full token.
sara: Edge-case: duplicated project names across orgs. Must ensure token binds org id not human-readable name.
kate-product: Launch criteria (prod checklist): - PRD approved, - RFC merged, - e2e test (scoped read/write + rotation), - Console UI to create/revoke keys, - Audit log view. Anything missing?
antoine: Add migration doc + customer communication plan to the checklist. Also legal review for retention of logs.
caroline: Good catch. Risk: rolling out without rotation enforcement might lock customers into insecure keys. Proposal: GA requires rotation endpoint and one-time forced rotation ability for org admins.
mike: Dev question: do we allow nested scopes (project:dataset)? I'd prefer keep scope to project level for v1.
sara: Agreed — project-level only v1. Track per-dataset as wishlist.
kate-product: I'll assemble product acceptance matrix from Antoine's and mine and drop into RFC.
caroline: Great. Can folks ack if they can deliver the acceptance bits this week?
antoine: I can draft migration & RFC updates today.
mike: I'll prototype token format + cache changes tomorrow.
sara: I'll write the e2e test cases and edge-case docs.
kate-product: I'll own customer comms + Console checklist.
caroline: Awesome. Last thing — please @mention me when you push RFC changes. Thanks! :thumbsup:
